# How Do I Run Corporate Short-Stay Operations Across Multiple Branches?


You run corporate short-stay operations across branches by giving each regional unit the same base process for corporate housing, while headquarters keeps consolidated visibility across all of them. On **Jestor** , this works because multiple entities connect under the same structure, priced by users.


Short stay operations focused on corporate housing, traveling employees, extended-stay business contracts, tend to grow regionally, with each branch building its own independent process.


## What complicates multi-branch corporate operations


- Each regional branch operating with its own local corporate housing process
- No consolidated view for headquarters across all regional units
- Corporate contracts with different terms managed inconsistently
- Billing and reconciliation with corporate clients requiring manual effort per branch


## How consolidated corporate operations management works


- A shared process model applies to every connected regional branch
- Corporate contracts stay versioned and connected to the relevant branch
- Multiple **Omie** accounts across regions connect under the same panel
- Consolidated dashboards give headquarters visibility over corporate occupancy across regions


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Pricing scales by users, not the number of branches connected
- A shared process model keeps corporate service consistency across regions
- Native ERP integration keeps corporate billing aligned with finance
- Scales the same way for a handful of branches or a larger regional network


Without consolidation With unified corporate operations


Each branch builds its own process Shared model, central visibility


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does each branch need a separate license?** No, pricing is based on users, not branches or entities. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Can corporate contracts have different terms per client?** Yes, each contract can have its own terms, connected to the relevant branch and client.


**Can headquarters see corporate occupancy across all regions?** Yes, through a consolidated dashboard.
